_doc: ⚑ S332 — THE PLACES LIST (src/desktop/apps/placesList.ts), job 2 of 2016 (DESIGN_2016_CONNECTIONS_2026-11-08.md, his second answers: 'a user post names The Wick: "a lesbian bar, all welcome". The network keeps a list of places to avoid. Vera must approve adding The Wick to it.'). Then Orla's message arrives ('quiz at the wick tonight…') and the stamp card on her desk is stamped BANNED (room prop, texture redrawn once). ⚑ DOCUMENTED vs INFERRED: a ministry session advising a woman to avoid lesbian venues is documented (SMH, 9 Mar 2018, mirrored by ABBI; RESEARCH_2016_VERA_APPARATUS §4 row 4). ⚑ S357 (his find, 10 Nov): a ministry's own MAP of safe and forbidden places is documented too — Garrard Conley on Love in Action's map of the city (2004; Insider video; e3_theday source 22, Dossier `places`). Keeping the list ONLINE, and a platform job that adds to it, remain the piece's inference. The member's post is felt (her words are never commented on); the list and the rule are operable. Every place is invented.
